## Purpose

This document defines the governance structure for the project.
It applies to all contributors and reviewers.

## Scope

The scope covers EN and RU structural drift.
The documentation ensures consistency across repositories.
Documentation remains the core responsibility of all reviewers.

## Rules

Every change must pass the quality gates.
No exceptions for inline code or numerical literals.
